title: The Firefly's Lantern
character: Flick, a small firefly with a brown body, big kind eyes and a soft yellow glow at the tip of his tail.
palette: lavender, dusky blue, glow yellow, moss green, soft brown.
sky: peach → lavender → dusky blue. The sky is never black or navy; night is shown as pale lavender.
cover: Flick glowing above a pond at twilight, his light reflected in the water.
style: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in soft coloured pencil: visible pencil strokes and gentle hatching, rounded shapes, warm paper grain showing through, thin dark-brown pencil outlines, a limited palette of five muted colours plus cream, no digital gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are pale lavender or cream, never black or navy, even at night; glowing things are drawn as pale yellow halos on a light sky. Dark tones only in outlines and small accents, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.

pages.text: When the sun goes down, Flick the firefly wakes up. His little lantern blinks on.
pages.beat: Flick on a blade of grass, tail glowing, peach sky.

pages.text: The moth flutters to the porch light, then finds a leaf to rest on. Flick lights the way.
pages.beat: Soft brown moth settling on a leaf near a glowing porch lamp, Flick beside it.

pages.text: The crickets tune up: chirp, chirp, chirp, all along the fence.
pages.beat: Three crickets on a wooden fence rail, Flick hovering.

pages.text: The jumping spider in the fence post says goodnight with a wave of two tiny legs. Flick blinks back.
pages.beat: Cute fuzzy jumping spider with big round eyes waving from a knot hole, Flick glowing nearby.

pages.text: The ladybugs are already asleep under a leaf, a little row of red buttons.
pages.beat: Row of ladybugs under a leaf, Flick's glow lighting them.

pages.text: The beetle trundles home along the path. Flick lights the way.
pages.beat: Round beetle on a garden path, Flick flying ahead with his light.

pages.text: The bees are all inside the hive, humming one low, sleepy hum.
pages.beat: Wooden beehive with a few bees at the door, Flick outside, lavender sky.

pages.text: The glow-worms in the bank turn on their tiny lights, one by one.
pages.beat: Mossy bank with small pale green glows, Flick above.

pages.text: The katydid sings her last song and goes quiet in the hedge.
pages.beat: Leaf-green katydid on a hedge leaf, Flick beside her.

pages.text: The moon comes up. Now the whole garden has a lantern.
pages.beat: Big moon over the garden, Flick small in the middle.

pages.text: Flick's friends blink back at him from the trees: on, off, on, off.
pages.beat: Several fireflies as soft yellow dots among tree leaves, Flick in front.

pages.text: Flick settles on a blade of grass, his lantern fading soft and slow. Goodnight, Flick.
pages.beat: Flick asleep on a grass blade, faint glow, pale lavender night.
